subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Data can guide people, but experience still matters.”?
options: Second, never leave cake where a smart dog can reach it.
A safer street began with people carefully recording what they saw.
A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.
A smart worker learns from both the screen and the street.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Second, never leave cake where a smart dog can reach it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A safer street began with people carefully recording what they saw.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Data can guide people, but experience still matters. A smart worker learns from both the screen and the street.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
